Innovative leadership approaches have been proposed to support workers’ mental wellbeing and build resilience at individual, organisational and system levels. However, to date there is still not a clear understanding of what resilience is at different levels and the role of leaders in promoting it. New knowledge is needed on how tools and interventions for leaders support their work on improving worker wellbeing and resilient performance.
